errors.evidence: The blue line for "Събиране на отпадъци" does not end at approximately the same value. It starts at around 338 and visibly decreases to about 330 by 2022.
The orange line ends at a value closer to 125 in 2022, not 127. The line peaks in 2021 and slightly drops in 2022.
The grey line for "Рециклиране на материали" does not increase in 2020. It peaks in 2019 at around 175 and then has a distinct dip in 2020 to a value of about 162.
The grey line does not drop in 2021; it rises sharply from its 2020 low of ~162 to ~178 in 2021.
The grey line ends at a value closer to 190 in 2022, making 184 a significant underestimation.
